title: Should You Cook With Olive Oil?
excerpt: Olive oil is stable under heat. But heat removes what makes a good oil worth using. The right question is not whether to cook with olive oil — it is which olive oil belongs in the pan.
seoTitle: Should You Cook With Olive Oil?
seoDescription: Olive oil is chemically stable under heat, more so than most seed oils. But heat destroys polyphenols and aromatics. Here is what survives, what does not, and which oil belongs in the pan.
